prompts.title: Studio hinter dem Bild
prompts.alt: Studio hinter dem Bild: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /behindTheScenes
prompts.promptText: Turn the reference portrait into a realistic behind-the-scenes studio photograph. Show the same man full body in front of a white seamless backdrop, with photographer, camera, softboxes, reflector and floor marks visible. Preserve his face, bald head, long dark beard, orange aviator glasses and turquoise hoodie.

prompts.title: Sechs Lichtstimmungen
prompts.alt: Sechs Lichtstimmungen: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /relightingGrid
prompts.promptText: Create a clean 2x3 relighting grid of the same portrait. Keep identity, pose, crop, expression, glasses, beard and hoodie identical. Change only the light: flat front light, soft window light, Rembrandt light, dramatic side light, split light and strong rim light.

prompts.title: Brennweitenvergleich
prompts.alt: Brennweitenvergleich: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /lensGrid
prompts.promptText: Create a five-panel portrait comparison of the same person photographed at 24mm, 35mm, 50mm, 85mm and 135mm. Keep subject distance and framing logically adjusted, identity and lighting consistent, and make perspective compression clearly visible.
prompts.testNote: Die Staffelung ist sauber, die Gesichtsperspektive unterscheidet sich aber weniger deutlich als bei einem echten kontrollierten Brennweitentest.

prompts.title: Mundformen für Sprache
prompts.alt: Mundformen für Sprache: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /visemeSheet
prompts.promptText: Create a clean 3x5 viseme reference sheet of the same person. Keep head angle, identity, glasses, beard, lighting and crop fixed. Show clearly different mouth shapes for silence, A, E, I, O, U, M/B/P, F/V, L, W/Q, wide smile, open jaw and rounded lips. No labels.

prompts.title: Gehzyklus
prompts.alt: Gehzyklus: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /walkCycle
prompts.promptText: Create an eight-frame side-view walk-cycle reference strip of the same man in turquoise hoodie, dark trousers and white sneakers. Show consecutive contact, down, passing and up phases on a plain white background. Preserve body proportions and identity.

prompts.title: Einstellungsgrößen
prompts.alt: Einstellungsgrößen: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /shotBreakdown
prompts.promptText: Create a clean 3x3 cinematography shot-size sheet of the same man: extreme close-up, close-up, medium close-up, medium shot, medium full shot, full shot, long shot, low angle and high angle. Preserve identity, outfit and white studio setting. No text.

prompts.title: Wärmebild
prompts.alt: Wärmebild: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /thermography
prompts.promptText: Transform the portrait into a convincing scientific thermal-camera image with a blue-to-red-to-yellow heat palette, visible temperature differences across face, glasses, beard and hoodie, dark blue background, same frontal identity.

prompts.title: Sichtbare Luftströmungen
prompts.alt: Sichtbare Luftströmungen: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /schlieren
prompts.promptText: Create a monochrome schlieren-photography portrait of the same man. Show fine refractive air currents curling around his face, beard and shoulders against a black background, silver edge detail, laboratory optical-imaging aesthetic.

prompts.title: Flachbettscanner-Porträt
prompts.alt: Flachbettscanner-Porträt: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /scanography
prompts.promptText: Recreate the portrait as true flatbed scanography: face and hoodie close to scanner glass, shallow depth, dark surrounding scanner lid, subtle dust and glass texture, hard lateral scanner light, slight contact distortion.
prompts.testNote: Der Scannerkontext ist eindeutig, die typische zeilenweise Scan-Anmutung könnte noch konsequenter sein.

prompts.title: Fotogramm
prompts.alt: Fotogramm: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /photogram
prompts.promptText: Turn the portrait into a high-contrast black-and-white darkroom photogram. Make the head, aviator glasses, beard and hoodie readable as direct-contact silhouettes and translucent outlines on aged photographic paper, with dust and chemical edge marks.

prompts.title: Chemigramm
prompts.alt: Chemigramm: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /chemigram
prompts.promptText: Create a handmade chemigram portrait on photographic paper using developer and fixer stains, branching chemical textures, sepia-black tonal blooms and distressed paper edges. Keep the man recognisable through glasses, bald head, beard and smile.
prompts.testNote: Das Ergebnis ist stark, wirkt stellenweise aber eher wie Tusche oder Ätzzeichnung als eindeutig wie ein Chemigramm.

prompts.title: Slit-Scan-Verzerrung
prompts.alt: Slit-Scan-Verzerrung: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /slitScan
prompts.promptText: Create a horizontal slit-scan portrait: keep the left half of the man's face recognisable and stretch the right half into long time-sliced horizontal bands. Preserve turquoise and orange colour cues on a black background.

prompts.title: Fadenbild
prompts.alt: Fadenbild: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /stringArt
prompts.promptText: Rebuild the portrait as real nail-and-thread string art mounted on a circular wooden board. Use black thread for facial features and beard, orange thread for glasses and turquoise thread for the hoodie. Photograph the physical artwork.

prompts.title: Drahtskulptur
prompts.alt: Drahtskulptur: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /wirePortrait
prompts.promptText: Transform the subject into a freestanding wire portrait sculpture in a modern gallery. Use black, copper-orange and turquoise wire to define the bald head, glasses, beard, smile and hoodie. Realistic shadows and physical construction.

prompts.title: Gepresste Pflanzen
prompts.alt: Gepresste Pflanzen: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /pressedFlowers
prompts.promptText: Create the portrait as a handmade collage of pressed flowers, leaves and petals on textured cream paper. Use orange petals for glasses, dark botanicals for beard and blue petals for the hoodie. Preserve the recognisable smile.

prompts.title: Sandskulptur
prompts.alt: Sandskulptur: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /sandSculpture
prompts.promptText: Turn the same man into a highly detailed life-size sand sculpture on a beach. Sculpt the bald head, aviator glasses, beard texture, smile and hoodie folds entirely from wet sand. Natural daylight and ocean background.

prompts.title: Eisskulptur
prompts.alt: Eisskulptur: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /iceSculpture
prompts.promptText: Transform the portrait into a transparent carved ice bust outdoors at blue hour. Preserve glasses, beard curls, smile and hoodie silhouette in clear ice with bubbles, frost and cyan reflections.

prompts.title: Buchschnitt-Porträt
prompts.alt: Buchschnitt-Porträt: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /foreEdgePainting
prompts.promptText: Show a real closed hardcover book whose fanned page edges reveal a detailed fore-edge painting of the reference portrait. Preserve orange glasses, dark beard and turquoise hoodie; warm library setting, realistic paper texture.

prompts.title: Drohnen-Lichtbild
prompts.alt: Drohnen-Lichtbild: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /droneLightShow
prompts.promptText: Create a night photograph of a large outdoor drone light show forming the man's portrait in the sky. Thousands of blue, orange and white light points clearly define his bald head, glasses, beard, smile and hoodie.

prompts.title: Klangmuster-Porträt
prompts.alt: Klangmuster-Porträt: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /cymatics
prompts.promptText: Create a real cymatics or Chladni-plate experiment in which fine sand on a vibrating black plate forms the man's recognisable face, orange glasses and turquoise hoodie, surrounded by standing-wave geometry. Laboratory macro photograph.

prompts.title: Leiterplatten-Porträt
prompts.alt: Leiterplatten-Porträt: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /pcbPortrait
prompts.promptText: Design a functioning black printed circuit board whose copper traces, vias and components form the reference portrait. Orange copper defines glasses and facial features; turquoise traces define the hoodie. Top-down product photograph.

prompts.title: Oszilloskop-Linienbild
prompts.alt: Oszilloskop-Linienbild: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /oscilloscope
prompts.promptText: Display the man's portrait as a continuous green vector trace on a vintage analog oscilloscope CRT. Clearly draw the bald head, aviator glasses, beard, smile and hoodie in glowing phosphor lines; dark workshop setting.

prompts.title: Lentikulardruck
prompts.alt: Lentikulardruck: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /lenticular
prompts.promptText: Photograph a physical lenticular portrait print in a clear acrylic frame. Visible vertical ridges combine two expressions of the same man while preserving orange glasses and turquoise hoodie; oblique light proves the real lenticular surface.

prompts.title: Hologramm-Büste
prompts.alt: Hologramm-Büste: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /hologram
prompts.promptText: Create a realistic tabletop volumetric hologram projector displaying a cyan-blue bust of the same smiling man. Preserve bald head, orange glasses, long beard and hoodie silhouette as luminous scan lines in a dark room.

prompts.title: Verwackeltes Nachtfoto
prompts.alt: Verwackeltes Nachtfoto: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /rawPhoneNight
prompts.promptText: Make this look like a raw handheld phone snapshot outside a convenience store at night: slight motion blur, imperfect focus, mixed neon and fluorescent light, wet pavement, casual framing. Preserve the same person and clothes.

prompts.title: Direktblitz-Schnappschuss
prompts.alt: Direktblitz-Schnappschuss: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /pointAndShoot
prompts.promptText: Recreate the portrait as a late-1990s point-and-shoot film snapshot indoors: harsh direct flash, dark background, visible grain, slight red-eye, casual off-centre crop and date-free lab-print aesthetic.

prompts.title: Frühe Digitalkamera
prompts.alt: Frühe Digitalkamera: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /digicam2003
prompts.promptText: Turn this into an early-2000s compact digital-camera photo: cool white balance, blown flash highlights, mild JPEG artefacts, deep depth of field, ordinary living-room background and unpolished consumer-camera realism.

prompts.title: Soft-Mist-Porträt
prompts.alt: Soft-Mist-Porträt: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /softMist
prompts.promptText: Create a cinematic portrait using a strong black-pro-mist diffusion filter: glowing highlights, soft halation around the orange glasses, low-contrast shadows, shallow depth of field and gentle window light. Keep identity accurate.

prompts.title: Nachtportrait mit Blitz
prompts.alt: Nachtportrait mit Blitz: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /directFlash
prompts.promptText: Photograph the same man outdoors at blue hour with strong on-camera direct flash. Bright crisp subject, dark city background, specular highlights on orange glasses, candid documentary energy, no studio polish.

prompts.title: 360-Grad-Werkstatt
prompts.alt: 360-Grad-Werkstatt: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /equirectangular360
prompts.promptText: Place the same man inside a fully detailed maker workshop and render a true 2:1 equirectangular 360-degree panorama with ceiling and floor distortion, seamless left and right edges and the subject standing near the centre.
prompts.testNote: Die typische 360-Grad-Verzerrung ist sichtbar, der aus der Vergleichstafel geschnittene Einzeltest liegt aber quadratisch statt im geforderten 2:1-Format vor.

prompts.title: Suchbild in der Menge
prompts.alt: Suchbild in der Menge: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /crowdSearch
prompts.promptText: Create a dense overhead photo of a busy maker convention with hundreds of people and booths. Hide the same bald bearded man in orange glasses and turquoise hoodie clearly but not centrally, like a classic visual search puzzle.

prompts.title: Creator-Livestream
prompts.alt: Creator-Livestream: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /creatorLivestream
prompts.promptText: Create a realistic vertical creator livestream interface showing the same man at a workbench presenting a small electronic build. Include camera view, readable live comments, viewer count and reaction controls without using real platform branding.

prompts.title: Sechs Produktansichten
prompts.alt: Sechs Produktansichten: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /productAngleGrid
prompts.promptText: Create a clean 2x3 product-photography grid of the exact unbranded black mirrorless camera: three-quarter front, side, top, lens close-up, in-hand scale and exploded lens view. Keep geometry and materials consistent.

prompts.title: Shopseite
prompts.alt: Shopseite: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /productDetailPage
prompts.promptText: Design a polished German mobile e-commerce product-detail page for the exact black mirrorless camera. Include image gallery, title, rating, price, feature cards, delivery, accessories and purchase buttons. Clean teal-accented UI.

prompts.title: Technische Zerlegung
prompts.alt: Technische Zerlegung: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /museumBreakdown
prompts.promptText: Create a German museum-style technical breakdown poster of the exact black mirrorless camera. Show the complete camera plus separated lens groups, sensor, shutter, circuit board, housings, controls, battery, material samples and assembly sequence.

prompts.title: Premium-Werbemotiv
prompts.alt: Premium-Werbemotiv: echtes Ergebnis des Prompts /premiumProductAd
prompts.promptText: Create a premium cinematic advertising image of the exact unbranded black mirrorless camera floating above a dark stone pedestal. Use cyan edge light, warm amber rim light, subtle particles and a macro inset of the control dial. No logo or slogan.
